result:
Tags on posts are implemented, and `pnpm typecheck` passes. I did not boot the app or run the acceptance flows, so runtime behaviour is unverified beyond the typecheck.

The schema in `db/schema.ts` adds `tags` (unique `name`) and `post_tags` (composite key on `post_id`, `tag_id`, with cascade deletes and an index on `tag_id`). `db/migrations/20261019223129_faithful_molecule_man.sql` was generated with `void db generate`. The tag rules live in `lib/validators.ts` as a `tags` field on the post payload, so a violation is reported on `tags` the same way an empty title is. `lib/tags.ts` holds the save logic (create missing tags, replace the post's attachments), the attach-tags-to-posts helper, and the filter condition. The create, edit and update handlers in `pages/posts/` use these, and `index.server.ts` adds the `tag` filter with pagination and counts respecting it. The posts list and post page show each tag as a link to `/posts?tag=…`; the create and edit forms have a Tags input, and the edit form starts with the current tags. Nothing is committed.
